method: Opened both sources for each of 31 new links and read supporting passages independently. WRH PDFs inaccessible through web were fetched with curl and read using pdftotext (Beat Instrumental February 1975, Melody Maker 19 October 1968, NME 15 January 1972, Record Mirror 4 January 1964). Rejected inaccessible R&R/R&B Report URLs were replaced by researcher with accessible independent interview/official biography before final review. Existing factual links retained; newly added annotations and stories reviewed against those facts. SHA256 binds canonical full link JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon).
